Alex G: quick status check for the perf sprint — pushing a tiny async check here, want to align owners and blockers before EOD :wave:
Maria P: thanks — will drop a short list. main things: kernel patchset, continuous-batching hook, kv-cache eviction tuning
Chen W: kernel patchset (PR#8342) landed on my fork, needs review + CI flakes fixed. perf bench shows ~6% token latency improvement locally
Jordan L: re: CI flakes — I saw a timeout in integration-test-3 that's new. i'll add a retry wrapper, pinging infra to bump ephemeral GPU limits for that job
Alex G: ownership: Chen owns kernel PR and perf numbers, Jordan owns CI fix and canary. Maria, can you own kv eviction tuning and watch memory tail?
Maria P: yep i can take kv eviction tuning. quick plan: 1) reduce default cold_ttl from 300s->120s, 2) add a sampling metric for prefix-hit-rate, 3) run A/B on dedupe keys. I'll open tickets
Chen W: adding benchmark notes here: run `./bench/run_perf.sh --model=redwood-7b --seq=1024 --clients=32` and collect `latency.p95` and `kv_hit_rate`
Jordan L: infra queue updated, adding `retries: 2` to the flaky job. Deploy bot scheduled a small canary at 19:00 PST
SRE Bot: deploy-canary started by Jordan L at 2025-03-12T19:00:12Z — groups: kernel-canary, kv-tune. Monitor: /dash/infra/canaries/7165432100
Maria P: on metrics, quick snippet i used to query prefix hits: ```curl -s 'https://metrics.internal/api/v1/query?query=avg%20kv_prefix_hit_rate%20by%20(job)' | jq .```
Alex G: question for Chen — kernel change touches kernel ABI for kv cache callback. Is there a compatibility shim for older dedicated nodes?
Chen W: yes, added a thin shim in `kernel/compat/kv_cb_v1_adapter.cc`. It's behind `#ifdef KV_CB_V1`, default off. We need to decide if we enable by default for Dedicated rollout
Jordan L: recommend opt-in for first week of canary, then enable cluster-wide. avoids unexpected crashes on older infra
Maria P: dependency note: models-team needs the continuous-batching hook merged to validate burst patterns for their evals. their test run is scheduled Wed morning — so we need both kernel PR and kv tuning merged by Tuesday EOD
Alex G: timeline acked. action items: Chen => finish CI fixes & request review (PR#8342); Jordan => merge CI retry and start canary; Maria => open kv tuning RFC + A/B tickets and coordinate with models-team. I'll follow up in the Monday sync if anything slips
Chen W: will request review in next 30m, leaving a perf log snippet in the PR description (p95: 42ms -> 39ms)
Maria P: one micro ask — please add a short test that asserts `kv_prefix_hit_rate` doesn't regress by >3% on canary runs. I can add the test harness if helpful
Alex G: great. last call: anyone blocking on access or creds?
Jordan L: none from my side. infra has granted test-sa for canary jobs
Chen W: no blocks. thanks all, pinging reviewers now :rocket:
Maria P: I'll post the A/B config in `#eng-runtime` channel once tickets are open. tagging models-team afterwards
Alex G: awesome — thanks everyone. closing the async loop here, will mark follow-ups as tasks in the sprint board :white_check_mark:
